ruleRoutingGuidance.belongs: directed folder-access graph rules — which directories may never reference which, plus the exceptions each rule allows
ruleRoutingGuidance.excludes: where a file should live or naming conventions — that is basics file-placement, not an access barrier

questions.prompt: What should these barriers accomplish — which folders must never reference which (imports, paths, docs included), and what architectural boundary does each separation protect?
questions.distill: derive the directed edge list into this entry's config as { "rules": [{ "from": "<dir>", "to": "<dir>" }] }; if no separation is wanted yet, record that as the answer and leave config unset
